rootCause: All balance reads and updates use the same object monitor.
triggerCondition: Concurrent credit, debit and balance calls on one Ledger instance.
expectedImpact: No lost update or check-then-act race within these operations.
counterevidence: Credit, debit and balance are synchronized; synchronized itself is not a defect.
verificationProcedure: Run bounded concurrent operations and check invariants; do not infer races from a keyword.
rationale: All balance reads and updates use the same object monitor. Credit, debit and balance are synchronized; synchronized itself is not a defect.

rootCause: Controller rejects nonpositive credit and domain service also guards bounds.
triggerCondition: Credit request amount is zero or negative.
expectedImpact: Controlled bad request before state update.
counterevidence: Ledger has additional positive-value and overflow guards.
verificationProcedure: Invoke credit(0) through MVC and assert HTTP 400 with unchanged balance.
rationale: Controller rejects nonpositive credit and domain service also guards bounds. Ledger has additional positive-value and overflow guards.
